nodes.text: a long way, into the remotest wildernesses
And there in a dark cave lived
an old man, full of spells and sorceries,
and foremost in the service of the gods.
He was called Theodas by name. The king
loved him greatly and held him as
a perfect friend of his, and the greatest
and most esteemed master. So said the king,
that from his prophecies and magic
he had got all his honour and power. And when those
priests full of wickedness found Theodas the sorcerer,
